correctness.rationale: For 0<=N<2^(3m), split into three m-bit blocks x,y,w. Q divides N iff x+y+w in {0,Q,2Q,3Q}; zero excluded and 3Q gives unique all-ones triple. Complement exchanges Q and 2Q, changing weight d to 3m-d. Carry automaton for sum Q has transitions 0->0 count 3 weight1, 0->1 count1 weight3, 1->0 count1 weight0, 1->1 count3 weight2. Return paths: loops at 0 contribute m; any excursion of length L raises weight L-1, so A_m support m..2m-1, complemented support m+1..2m. Two-block analysis and k=2^m+2, 2^m+3 calculations establish least weight m+1. Trace=3z(1+z), det=8z^3 yields Cayley-Hamilton recurrence. Independent newly written enumeration and matrix multiplication agreed for all m=2..8 (87,891 total multipliers), including sharp boundaries and gap; finite test corroborative, not proof.
